Cc: Eva Lindholm <eva@lindholmadvisors.com>

Subject: Proposal: skill-handoff for Cascade field team

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking time earlier this week. Cascade is gearing up to recommend Redwood to three strategic clients this quarter; before we go live we want a short, repeatable handoff that ensures our consultants can:

- run quick proof-of-concepts using Dedicated and hosted fallbacks
- demonstrate latency/cost tradeoffs to enterprise IT
- run the Redwood Console for tracing and per-route dashboards

I've attached a one-pager (Cascade_SKILL-HANDOFF_v1.pdf) that sketches a 3-week sequence we call a "skill handoff": shadow session, lab bench exercise, and joint co-delivery practice. Quick asks: could Redwood provide a 2-hour field enablement slot the week of May 5, and a lab environment with an example sandbox model and trace logs we can use during sessions?

If this aligns, Eva and I can share the consultant roster.

Best,
Alan
Senior Engagement Lead
Cascade Consulting

2) Lab environment: we can provision a short-lived sandbox (hosted model + Dedicated variant) with a tracing link and sample evals for your consultants.
3) Roster + scope: please send consultant list and target customer use cases — we'll build tailored lab exercises.

Marissa / Rishi — looping you in to confirm operational lead and lab provisioning ETA. Can Marissa take point on the workshop content and Rishi on the sandbox provisioning? Also copying PrIyom for rollout/partner ops cadence planning.

Proposed next step: a 30-min planning call April 15 to finalize learning objectives. Alan / Eva — does that time work?

Quick note — happy to lead content. Draft plan below (will flesh into slides):

Workshop (2 hours)
- 0:00–0:15: Intros + goals (Vanessa/Alan)
- 0:15–0:45: Architecture primer: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (short demos)
- 0:45–1:10: Live lab: deploy sample prompt set, watch trace + token cost
- 1:10–1:40: Troubleshooting & common procurement questions (security/compliance bullets)
- 1:40–2:00: Next steps + mutual action plan

Lab bench exercises (self-paced)
- Exercise 1: latency tuning with batching and quantization
- Exercise 2: KV cache warmup demo + cost before/after
- Exercise 3: rollouts: canary vs A/B with fallback model

- Rishi: can we get a sandbox with a 4-week TTL, preloaded model, and an admin trace URL by April 28?
